create_pipeline_wan_i2v: create a Wan image-to-video pipeline for generating videos from a single input image and text prompt
run_pipeline_image_to_video: run the Wan image-to-video pipeline to generate a video with specified height, width, num_frames, and guidance scale
encode_prompt_t5: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with configurable max sequence length and batch duplication
encode_image_clip: encode an input image into CLIP vision embeddings using the image encoder for conditioning the video generation
prepare_video_latents: prepare latent variables and video conditions from input images with VAE encoding and temporal masking
